chunks.title: Q3 Analyze a Problem & Propose a Solution w/ Calculations (10 points) — Set 2: coal surface mining
chunks.content: AP Environmental Science FRQ 3, 'Analyze an Environmental Problem and Propose a Solution' with a calculation component, 10 points across parts A–G (calculation parts award a setup point AND an answer point), same task template as Set 1. Set 2 topic: coal surface mining near a town. Answer key highlights: A [P1] identify a type of surface mining to access coal (e.g., strip mining, mountaintop removal, open-pit). B [P2] describe an environmental problem associated with surface mining (habitat destruction, erosion/sedimentation, acid mine drainage). C [P3] describe an environmental problem the town could experience. D [P4+] propose a realistic local-government solution and later calculation parts follow (setup + answer each). Common failure: identifying underground rather than surface mining in A; calculation parts missing the shown setup or using wrong units. Show-your-work is required for the setup points.

chunks.content: Q3 (Set 2) scored 10/10 — earned every part: surface-mining identification, mining and town environmental problems, the proposed local solution, and all calculation setup-and-answer points with correct work and units. Full-credit model for the calculation FRQ.
